verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The only hint is the "/v1" segment in the base URL, which on its own does not show versioning commitments or deprecation timelines. Prompt-library version tracking concerns prompts, not the API contract, so it is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
